meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: Claude 会先判断任务类型,加载对应的设计规则,并在写任何界面代码前要求你同意建立一份 DESIGN.md 设计系统文档;之后按文档实现组件,再用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse 性能检查并做视觉对比。
howto.when: 当你说到“frontend”“UI/UX”“design”等词,或要求做网页开发、改样式、搭建 React 项目、做性能/无障碍检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个落地页,风格类似 Linear。
say.note: 会先建设计系统再实现页面。

say.text: 给我这个 React 页面跑一下 Lighthouse 性能审计。
say.note: 用真实浏览器检查并给出报告。

say.text: 照着这张截图重做我的界面,保持风格一致。
say.note: 会提取截图里的颜色和布局来重写。

howto.what_en: Claude routes the task to the relevant design ruleset, requires a DESIGN.md design-system document to exist before writing any UI code, then implements components against that contract and finishes with real-browser Lighthouse audits and visual comparison.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention frontend, UI/UX, design, or ask for web work, restyling, React setup, or performance/accessibility checks.

say_en.text: Help me design a landing page in the style of Linear.
say_en.note: Creates a design system first, then builds the page.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse performance audit on this React page.
say_en.note: Uses a real browser and reports the results.

say_en.text: Recreate my UI from this screenshot, keeping the same style.
say_en.note: Extracts colors and layout from the image and rewrites the code.
